about_short_description.short_description: Yardbook provides marketplace & business software for Landscapers.

product.name: Yardbook Landscaping Business Software
product.description: A cloud-based software platform for managing landscaping and lawn care businesses, including customer management, job scheduling, estimates, billing, and payments.

product.name: Yardbook Public Business Profile
product.description: An online profile page for landscapers to showcase services, attract customers, and manage inbound leads from a single platform.

product.name: Yardbook Payment Processing Integration
product.description: Integration with Stripe for processing credit and debit card payments, including transaction management and fee handling.

product.name: Yardbook Job and Task Scheduling
product.description: A scheduling system for assigning, routing, and tracking landscaping jobs, tasks, and employee timesheets.

product.name: Yardbook Customer and Lead Management
product.description: A system to manage customer information, leads, estimates, and communications via text and email.
